subject: Does Restart clearly reset the whole review set through a visible resetting state and return to question 1 without restarting the application?
acceptanceCriteria: Restart is understood as resetting all M038 review decisions/state rather than restarting or rebuilding the application.
The resetting state visibly communicates activity while queued writes drain and reset authority executes.
Successful reset clears reviewer-facing state and returns to question 1.
waiverPolicy: No implicit waiver. M038 changes the human-review UI itself, so these blocking UX/visual items require repository-user approval.
